intro: San Francisco's public sauna options range from Archimedes Banya, a large Russian-style bathhouse on the Bay in Hunters Point, to Japanese-inspired communal baths in Japantown and the Tenderloin. Newer spots include a waterfront barrel sauna with a cold plunge at Crane Cove Park and a sauna garden on Post Street. Most venues take reservations, and several rotate between co-ed and single-gender days, so check the schedule before you go.

venues.name: Archimedes Banya
venues.drop_in_price: $72 Basic Banya Pass (3-hour entry); $60 weekday Happy Hour pass (entry 12-4pm, 3 hours); $95 All Day Pass
venues.session_length: 3 hours (Basic and Happy Hour passes) or all day
venues.schedule: 18+ with valid government ID. Mon, Wed, Thu, Fri 12pm-11pm; Sat-Sun 10am-11pm; last check-in 9pm. Women's Night 5-10pm on the first Tuesday of the month and Men's Night 5-10pm on the third Tuesday.
venues.notes: Two Russian saunas with large tiled stoves (170-210°F), a Finnish dry sauna, a Turkish hammam steam room, warm pools, jacuzzis, a bar mezzanine and a roof deck with Bay views. Aromatherapy sessions daily at 3pm, 7pm and 9pm. Heat source for the saunas is not stated, so treat the type as approximate.

venues.name: Kabuki Springs & Spa
venues.drop_in_price: $49 communal bath (any day); $20 with a booked spa service
venues.schedule: Reservations required. Women: Sun, Wed, Fri (bathing suit optional). Men: Thu, Sat (bathing suit optional). All gender: Mon, Tue (bathing suits required). Hours Mon 2pm-8pm, Tue-Sun 10am-9:30pm. Photo ID required; ages 12-18 only with a parent or guardian.
venues.notes: Japanese-inspired communal bathhouse in the Japan Center, open since 1968. Hot pool (104°F), cedar-lined dry sauna (150°F), steam room (120°F) and seated Japanese-style showers. Quiet house: no talking and no phones in the baths.

venues.name: Onsen Bath & Restaurant
venues.schedule: 18+. Mon 4pm-10pm men (bathing suit optional); Wed 4pm-10pm women (bathing suit optional); Thu 2pm-10pm co-ed; Fri-Sun 10am-10pm co-ed (bathing suits required on co-ed days). Reservations recommended; walk-ins welcome based on availability. Max 4 guests per reservation.
venues.notes: Small Japanese sento-style bathhouse with a 104°F communal tub, redwood sauna and steam room. Robe, towel, sandals, locker and tea included. Bath + dinner option Thursday-Sunday. No refunds on cancellations within 24 hours. Garage across the street at 469 Eddy St.

venues.name: Dogpatch Paddle Waterfront Sauna
venues.address: 701 Illinois St, Unit A, San Francisco, CA 94107
venues.drop_in_price: $25 public session sauna only; $35 with cold plunge
venues.schedule: Public sessions Tue-Sun 9am-5pm, closed Mondays. Shared sessions up to 4 people; private sessions also available. Ages 16+. Walk-ins usually available on quiet weekdays; reserve ahead on weekends.
venues.notes: Barrel sauna kept around 190°F, steps from the Bay at Crane Cove Park, run by a kayak and SUP rental shop. Showers, lockers and a changing room included. Bring swimwear and a towel; towels are required in the sauna and rent for $2.

venues.name: Alchemy Springs Sauna Garden
venues.schedule: Limited hours posted on the booking page. 18+ (per secondary guide).
venues.notes: A sauna garden open as a preview of a full bathhouse the operator says is opening soon. A local guide describes a large communal sauna with plunge tubs and outdoor showers and says to bring your own towel, robe and sandals. Check the booking page for current times and prices.
